description: CTO MISSION CONTRACT VALIDITY §A.3/§A.5: the OBSOLETE transition currently requires the mission contract to be ABSENT, so an abandoned PLACEHOLDER whose (gitignored stub) contract still exists (e.g. __none__) can never be cleared. Minimal correction distinguishing a demonstrated placeholder from a real contract: extend OBSOLETE eligibility to a placeholder mission id (pattern ^__<word>__$) — a reserved/placeholder convention no real mission uses (verified: only __none__ in the ledger, zero in ROADMAP). NON-DESTRUCTIVE (history preserved). HARD GUARD unchanged for real-named missions: a present-contract, non-placeholder mission is NEVER obsoleted (fail-closed intact). Both ports.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION CONTRACT VALIDITY AND EVIDENCE-BASED INCIDENT CLOSURE §A.3 (minimal factory/validity correction) + §A.5 (OBSOLETE for a demonstrated abandoned placeholder).

work_item_contract.objective: isPlaceholderMissionId(m) (pattern ^__<word>__$) + extend resolveObsoleteIncidents so an OPEN/FROZEN incident is OBSOLETE when (contract ABSENT) OR (placeholder id). Real-named present-contract missions stay fail-closed FROZEN (never obsoleted). Record obsoletedReason distinguishing 'contract absent' vs 'abandoned placeholder id'.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: EVIDENCE: __none__ (FROZEN) is a factory placeholder for a degenerate id ('None'); not in ROADMAP; no production references (only itself + stale generated scans); gitignored stub contract. The §A OBSOLETE gate (contract-absent only) can't reach it (contract file exists) ⇒ stuck FROZEN. SAFETY: pattern ^__<word>__$ matches ONLY __none__ in the ledger and ZERO roadmap ids. PLAN: add a placeholder-id OBSOLETE path, strictly gated, non-destructive.
work_item_contract.scope: self-diagnostic (both ports): isPlaceholderMissionId + one OR-clause in resolveObsoleteIncidents + reason text. Extend incident-obsolete.test.ts. incident-recurrence already excludes OBSOLETE (unchanged). No other behavior touched. The broader factory contractValidity classifier (NO_CAPABILITY/ALREADY_SATISFIED) is NOT built here — those classes are not cleanly factory-determinable and are handled by documentation (§A.4/§B); only the PLACEHOLDER distinction is implemented (the minimal demonstrated-needed correction).
invariants: EVIDENCE-GATED: placeholder OBSOLETE ONLY for id matching ^__<word>__$ (reserved/placeholder convention; verified no real/roadmap mission uses it).
FAIL-CLOSED INTACT: a real-named (non-placeholder) mission with an existing contract is NEVER obsoleted; RESOLVED/OBSOLETE never re-transitioned.
NON-DESTRUCTIVE: status transition only; id/attempts/createdAt/divergences preserved; obsoletedReason records the basis (absent-contract vs placeholder).
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic test: placeholder-id FROZEN (contract present) ⇒ OBSOLETE; real-named present-contract FROZEN ⇒ UNCHANGED (fail-closed); absent-contract still ⇒ OBSOLETE; RESOLVED/OBSOLETE not re-transitioned; history preserved; dual-port parity. Non-regression self-diagnostic/cycle/ranking/incident-recurrence/incident-resolution/incident-obsolete ALL PASS. tsc 0. Applied LIVE: __none__ ⇒ OBSOLETE (reason=placeholder); BUILD_RUNTIME/REPAIR_ACTION/CM4/NL_IMPLEMENT_8693ADBF/DEPLOY stay FROZEN. Diff limited to write-set; committed.
stop_conditions: The pattern would match any real/roadmap mission; fail-closed for a real-named mission would be weakened; a path outside the write-set is needed.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/core/self-diagnostic.{js,ts} runtime/core/incident-obsolete.test.ts ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f runtime/missions/PLACEHOLDER_OBSOLETE_TRANSITION.json; npm run build:runtime.

objectives.goal: Demonstrated placeholder-id incidents become OBSOLETE; real-named present-contract missions stay fail-closed FROZEN; non-destructive; both ports; proven hermetic + live on __none__.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set.

definition_of_done: self-diagnostic marks a demonstrated placeholder-id incident OBSOLETE (distinct reason), real-named present-contract missions never obsoleted (fail-closed), history preserved; both ports; committed (no force). Minimal validity correction, NOT a weakening of fail-closed.
